==Description==
'''Whip''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that is bundled with the Meme Emotes gamepass which can be bought for {{Robux|55}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/208102650/profile ZerkomisticDynamic]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

==Gallery==
{{Gallery|
{{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}}
<gallery>
Whip.gif|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020)
</gallery>
}}

==Trivia==
*This emote is based on a similar dance move performed in Silento's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vjW8wmF5VWc Watch Me (Whip Nae Nae)] music video, hence the name.
*The second music used for this emote was a remixed version of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=etwIu8-FlGU Isley Brothers - FOOTSTEPS IN THE DARK].
*The fourth music used for this emote was the same music that [[Garry's Dance]] emote plays.
